texts.name: Chiyoko
texts.biography: Chiyoko more than anyone lives in interesting times. Born in the eastern Free City of Foster’s Reach, the call of Shalassa, the Dragon of Water, reached her at a young age, forcing her to abandon everything she knew in order to take up residence on the Naga island of Hashima. A respecter of the natural flow of the world, Chiyoko rose swiftly in the ranks of the Naga priesthood. She is recognized by her daimyo, Lord Hiroshi, as a useful, pliant bridge between Nagas and Humans.

specialty.name: Priestesses
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Coral Priestesses and Pearl Priestesses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
